 Charlotte hosts the red-hot Sixers on Halloween night
 Philadelphia 76ers' VJ Edgecombe, right, looks at LeBron James, left, after James made a basket during the second half of an NBA Cup basketball game against the New York Knicks, Friday, Oct. 30, 2026, in Philadelphia. (AP Photo/Chris Szagola) Chris Szagola

 Halloween night at the Spectrum Center promises sharp contrasts. The Charlotte Hornets, stuck in the middle of the Eastern Conference, host a Philadelphia 76ers team that has started the season as one of the most solid in the entire NBA. It is a clash between a club seeking stability and another that has, for now, settled among the elite of the Eastern Conference.
 LeBron James spins into the spotlight after vintage performance against Knicks When and where to watch the game between the Sixers and Hornets?
 The matchup will take place this Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time (5:00 p.m. Central Time and 3:00 a.m. Pacific Time) at the Spectrum Center in Charlotte, a venue with a capacity of 19,077 fans.
 In the United States, the national broadcast is carried by NBA TV; and in Charlotte and Philadelphia, you can follow the game on:
 Broadcast in Philadelphia: NBC Sports Philadelphia
 Broadcast in Charlotte: WSOC / TV64 (WAXN)
 As a general reference, the NBA season is distributed in the U.S. market among different networks, while locally this may vary.
 Sixers vs. Hornets overview: latest results and standings in the table
 The standings tell a clear story. Philadelphia comes in established in second place in the Eastern Conference and as the leader of the Atlantic Division, with a record of 5 wins and 1 loss after six games. In the league-wide standings, the Sixers appear in fourth place among the 30 teams, a sign of the great start they have put together.
 Charlotte, meanwhile, sits in seventh place in the East and is second in the Southeast Division, with a 3-3 record. The most concerning statistic in North Carolina is the point differential: the Hornets have scored 584 and allowed 636, a -52 that reveals serious defensive problems. In contrast, Philadelphia shows more balanced numbers, reflecting a team that knows how to close out games.
 The difference in the overall standings is telling: while the Sixers are tied with the leading pack, the Hornets sit in 16th place out of 30, two and a half games behind the top.
 The key duel: stars to spare in Charlotte
 The appeal of the night lies in the depth of talent that Philadelphia brings. The 76ers roster combines explosive youth with championship-tested veterans: point guard Tyrese Maxey and center Joel Embiid lead a group that also features hugely influential names like LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, along with shooting guard VJ Edgecombe, one of the young faces of the project. It is an unusual collection of talent for a team that, on paper, is aiming high this season.
 Charlotte responds with a younger group but with interesting pieces. Forward Brandon Miller is the go-to offensive piece, accompanied by German point guard Dennis Schröder, shooting guard Coby White, and power forward Naz Reid.
 The contribution of sharpshooter Grayson Allen and young players like Kon Knueppel and Liam McNeeley rounds out a rotation that needs to find consistency, especially on its home court.
 The tactical key seems obvious: if the Hornets do not improve their defensive performance —the major burden of their start— containing an offense as varied as Philadelphia's will be an uphill task.
 What’s at stake in the Eastern Conference
 For Philadelphia, a victory would solidify its position among the leaders in the East, where it shares an 83.3% win rate with the Detroit Pistons, the conference leaders by point differential.
 Keeping up the pace against theoretically inferior opponents is exactly what is expected of a contender, and this is one of those matchups that a team with ambition must handle.
 For Charlotte, the game is a golden opportunity to make a statement at home. They are tied with the Atlanta Hawks and the Washington Wizards in the fight for the Southeast Division, all with a 3-3 record. Beating a top-tier opponent would not only add a prestigious win, but would also strengthen their case to contend for the play-in spots in a tightly packed Eastern Conference middle tier.
 What is the prediction for the Philadelphia 76ers vs Charlotte Hornets?
 The numbers set the tone. Philadelphia comes in with a better record, a better point differential, and a roster full of proven talent, while Charlotte carries the worst point differential among the teams in the middle of the Eastern Conference.
 The advantage of playing at the Spectrum Center and a standout performance from Brandon Miller could keep the matchup close at times, but logic suggests that the 76ers will take the win in Charlotte. For the Hornets, limiting the defensive bleeding will be the only way to pull off an upset on Halloween night.
